items.title: Simon Willison ships a browser RTS game built almost entirely by coding agents
items.summary_en: Simon Willison describes Battle Drones, a browser-based real-time strategy game in the Command & Conquer style. He built it with coding agents, mainly Claude Code, over about 12 major iterations and 321 commits. Two nearby devices can play each other over audio, and an online mode uses a small WebSocket relay he estimates costs a couple of dollars a month.
